sealed_inputs.validation_status: PARTIALLY_OBSERVED_BEFORE_LOCK: aggregate outcomes and selected examples were already known; candidate outcomes remain unopened

common_definitions.completed_candle: Binance 1m candle with close_time_ms < evaluation_at_ms; valid OHLC; exact contiguous minute; duplicates or gaps make the candidate unavailable
common_definitions.baseline_favorable_close: a completed post-entry 1m close strictly greater than entry_price * 1.002
common_definitions.bearish_two: the latest two contiguous completed post-entry 1m candles both close below open and the second close is strictly below the first close
common_definitions.position_policy: only positions stamped at entry with a future adopted strategy version could use an adopted rule; existing OPEN positions retain their entry-time policy
common_definitions.no_mutation: no candidate may lower an existing stop, reset peak/partial state, bypass ownership, lease, fencing, circuit, scope, quantity, native-stop generation, settlement, or idempotency guards

candidates.problem: losses that never form QV3's favorable-close proof can fall through to the initial hard stop
available_information: validated completed 1m OHLC candles available at evaluation time
candidates.transition: While QV3 remains unarmed, close when bearish_two is true and both candle closes are strictly below entry price. Do not close on one candle, a gap, a duplicate, an incomplete candle, or any pre-entry candle.
candidates.difference_from_baseline: Baseline requires a favorable completed close above +0.2% before the same two-bearish structure can close. C1 covers only the unarmed failure state and adds the both-below-entry constraint.
candidates.expected_side_effect: normal two-minute pullbacks below entry may be exited before recovery
candidates.winner_preservation_target: no existing winner becomes a modeled loser and at least 90% of actual large-winner net value is retained

candidates.problem: an executable favorable bid can occur without a completed candle close, leaving QV3 unarmed before a reversal
available_information: current executable bid already read by the position manager
quote request, receive, exchange-book, and detection timestamps
candidates.transition: Persist a position-bound fresh-bid proof. Once either the baseline favorable-close proof or fresh-bid proof exists, close only when bearish_two is true.
candidates.difference_from_baseline: Only the arming proof is broadened; the two completed bearish descending candles and every execution guard remain unchanged.
candidates.expected_side_effect: a brief executable bid excursion can arm protection and later cut a trade that would have resumed upward
candidates.winner_preservation_target: no existing winner becomes a modeled loser and at least 90% of actual large-winner net value is retained

candidates.problem: combined coverage of never-favorable early failures and transient-favorable reversals
candidates.transition: Apply the union of C1 and C2; at the first qualifying evaluation, emit one close intent through the existing idempotent close path.
candidates.eligibility: C3 is evaluated regardless of individual results but can be selected only if both component mechanics reproduce correctly and C3 independently passes every gate.
candidates.winner_preservation_target: no existing winner becomes a modeled loser and at least 90% of actual large-winner net value is retained

explicitly_not_candidates.reason: the seven development reentries included four winners, every reentry used a new signal and newer completed signal bar, and the two after-loss reentries had already recovered above the prior entry; a blanket cooldown repeats the previously failed REPEAT_STOP_2 family
rank and momentum feature distributions did not cleanly separate losses, and validation-time pre-entry raw candles are incomplete; SPIKE_3PCT and LOCK_1P5 remain failed
development close-decision-to-fill latency had zero observations above 10 seconds; native protection ordering is not changed without validation evidence of starvation
initial stop widening, averaging down, leverage, margin, account capital, and slot-limit changes are prohibited

replay.development_candles: checksum-verified Binance Vision futures 1m candles, labeled post-hoc and never represented as bot-observed input
replay.development_evaluation_clock: actual recorded position-management decision timestamps and fresh bid observations
replay.validation_candles: raw candles stored by QV3 shadow at each historical evaluation
replay.validation_evaluation_clock: actual recorded position-management decision timestamps; never evaluate before the candle close
replay.same_entry_overlay: fix actual entry time, quantity, entry fills, and entry fees; if a candidate triggers before actual exit, model a full remaining-quantity exit at the contemporaneous executable bid after scenario impact and fee; otherwise retain the actual signed-fill result

delay_stress.execution_price: first actual fresh observed bid at or after trigger + 60000ms and before the actual exit; otherwise retain actual exit

replay.intrabar_rule: candidate signals use completed closes only; candle high is never used as an arming input; no assumption that a stop and high inside one candle occurred in a favorable order

gates_fixed_before_results.promotion: SUPERIOR only when every data, fidelity, sample, performance, operational-regression, and production-integration gate passes; otherwise DEFER or INFERIOR, with no strategy deployment
